title: 第一卷 第90章 围攻金阳城炼制筑基丹第一卷 第89章 妖核到手道友请留步
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 林寻闻言，不仅没回头，速度还快了几分。
在黑水山脉中，二阶妖兽的区域内不可飞行，容易被飞行的二阶妖兽视为挑衅。
不然，他早就驾驭金雷剑逃了。
要知道在这里，妖兽的凶险只是一部分。
每年不知有多少修士，并非死于妖兽，而是遭同类杀害。
所以要时刻保持警惕，他人即是地狱。
现在不管对方是寻求帮忙，还是其他，都意味着麻烦。
他已经获得了妖核，当然不想管。
眼看着林寻速度越来越快，富态中年猛然提速，再次追赶上去。
“道友，我乃慕家筑基老祖，自内围山脉而来，还请道友搭救！”
林寻眉头一皱，贴了张上品遁术符，速度再次快一大截。
求救？
是想让他送死吧？
可身后追击者的速度同样再次加快，声音也更加焦急
“道友！且听我一言，我慕家三大筑基，这次一起探索山脉内围发现了大秘密。
有大妖在集合，恐欲发动兽潮对金阳城不利啊！
我身上有确切证据，你若能助我一臂之力，到时候少不了好处！”
一阵狼嚎，从身后远处传来，同时伴随着二阶后期的强横气息！
富态中年浑身一颤，面露惊恐的威胁道，
“小友，快停下！
我若走不了，你也一定走不了！
若再不停下，老夫对你不客气了！”
林寻的脚步骤停，转身看过去。
他见到一位富态中年，法衣破损严重，明显经历大战。
富态中年手中死死抱住一只，带有月牙印记的狼崽子不放。
天月狼幼崽？
他瞬间就明白过来，什么围攻金阳城？
简直胡说八道！
这是偷幼崽被发现了，想拉他垫背？
“哈哈，小友快来助我！只要联手共渡此劫，到金阳城时，定有你.......”
然而，他的话还未说完。
林寻怒呵一声，两张符箓，同时轰出！
“嗯？你找死！”
富态中年显然没料到，一个炼气小辈，居然敢对他出手。
仓促间运起一层透明的护体光罩。
轰！
爆炸声后，富态中年的脚下竟然生根，瞬间被巨大藤蔓缠绕！
content_en:
;;
When Lin Xun heard this, not only did he not look back, but he also moved a little faster.
In the Blackwater Mountains, second-level monsters are not allowed to fly in the area, and flying second-level monsters can easily be regarded as a provocation.
Otherwise, he would have escaped long ago with the Golden Thunder Sword.
You must know that here, the danger of monsters is only part of it.
Every year, countless monks die not from monsters, but from their own kind.
So always be vigilant, other people are hell.
Now, whether the other party is asking for help or otherwise, it means trouble.
He has already obtained the demon core, so of course he doesn't want to care about it.
Seeing Lin Xun's speed getting faster and faster, the rich middle-aged man suddenly increased his speed and caught up again.
"Fellow Taoist, I am the founder of the Mu family. I came from the Inner Mountains. Please help me, fellow Taoist!"
Lin Xun frowned, affixed a high-grade escape talisman, and his speed became much faster again.
Help?
Do you want him to die?
But the speed of the pursuer behind him also increased again, and his voice became more anxious.
"Fellow Taoist! Listen to me, my Mu family has three major foundations. This time we explored the inner reaches of the mountains together and discovered a big secret.
There are big demons gathering, and they may launch a wave of beasts that will be detrimental to Jinyang City!
I have definite evidence on my body. If you can help me, it will be of great benefit when the time comes! "
Ouch~~
A howl of wolves came from far behind, accompanied by the powerful aura of the late second level!
The wealthy middle-aged man trembled all over and threatened with a frightened expression,
"Kid, stop it!
If I can't leave, you definitely can't leave either!
If you don't stop, I'll be rude to you! "
Lin Xun stopped and turned around to look over.
He saw a wealthy middle-aged man whose cassock was badly damaged and had obviously experienced a war.
The rich middle-aged man tightly held a wolf cub with a crescent mark in his hand and refused to let go.
Lunar wolf cub?
He understood instantly, why besieged Jinyang City?
What nonsense!
Is this because I was caught stealing a cub, and I want to take him as a backstop?
"Haha, little friend, come and help me! As long as we work together to overcome this disaster, I will definitely have you when we get to Jinyang City..."
However, his words were not finished yet.
"Get out!"
Lin Xun roared angrily, and two talismans were blasted out at the same time!
"Huh? You're looking for death!"
The rich middle-aged man obviously did not expect that a junior Qi refiner would dare to attack him.
In a hurry, a transparent protective mask was transported.
boom!
After the explosion, roots sprouted from the feet of the wealthy middle-aged man, and he was instantly entangled by huge vines!
